mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (task_id, user_id, task_type, status, context, error_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{taskType}, #{status}, #{context}, #{errorCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks SET context = #{context}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE tasks SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
UPDATE tasks SET error_count = error_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
